text:
anya: Heads up — after landing the kernel-selector change, I’m seeing a 10-12% throughput regression on paged+fused attention with interleaved KV when dtype=bf16 on G5.12x. @mike @rahul :eyes:

mike: any flamegraph or perf counters? which model / seq len / batch?

anya: quick repro / config:
```
model: opt-13b-like
seq: 2048
batch: 8
pre-change tokens/s: ~88k
post-change tokens/s: ~76k
hw: g5.12x, cuda12
kernel chosen: flash_attn_fused_paged_kv_bf16
perf snapshot:
  L2_bw: 210 GB/s
  global_load_bytes: 52 GB/s (up from 31 GB/s)
  sm_eff: 70%
  stall_mem: 20%
```

rahul: wow global_load_bytes jumped a lot. sounds like more unaligned/gather loads. interleaved layout + bf16 packing could change stride math and cause extra loads / bank conflicts.

sophia: we did change the selector to prefer fused_paged for seq > 1024 — maybe fused_paged assumes separate-kv layout alignment. could be a selector-assumption mismatch.

mike: can you try forcing kv_layout=separate in the runtime and rerun? quick check to isolate layout impact.

anya: ran that just now — separate layout restores perf to ~89k tokens/s (even a tiny bump). so combo is interleaved + fused_paged + bf16 = worst.

rahul: hypothesis: the fused kernel issues vectorized loads assuming 128-bit alignment per row. with bf16 (2 bytes) and interleaved packing the stride may not be multiple of 16 bytes -> extra unaligned loads and inefficient memory ops. also stride interacts with batching heuristics (we changed contiguous batching window recently).

sophia: options:
- selector: prefer separate for bf16+fused_paged
- runtime: pad stride to 16-element boundary (feature flag)
- kernel: add unaligned-safe path in fused_paged kernel or detect and fallback to flashvariant

mike: add a microbench for KV gather stride across dtypes/seqs. bench config snippet:
```
./bench_kv_gather --layout interleaved --dtype bf16 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --repeat 10
./bench_kv_gather --layout separate --dtype bf16 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --repeat 10
./bench_kv_gather --layout interleaved --dtype fp16 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --repeat 10
```

perf-bot: auto-bench run finished — attached summary (internal link): https://perf.internal/bench/2265432100 — shows bank_conflict_metric spike for interleaved+bf16+fused_paged :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

anya: I’ll open a PR with a conservative selector tweak (prefer separate for bf16 on fused_paged) + add pad-to-128b opt behind flag, and include the microbench as a unit in ci-perf. assigning to kernel team for follow-up.

rahul: also add a console metric for per-kernel global_load_bytes and bank_conflict_rate so we can detect regressions automatically.

sophia: sgtm. file an ENG-Runtime ticket (include perf logs & bench csv). thanks for triaging quickly :rocket:
